content: Jesúsʼbi, Bab-Dummadse-naegala igar-napiragwadid
Jesús e-sapinganga sogded: “Mer surbinsa be-gwagegi be itomalo. Bab-Dummadgi mer be bengumalo. Degine, mer angi be bengumarbalo.
An-Bab-neggi neg-nuegan-bukidar nikad. Ar degisulina, an bega sogosurmalanad, an bemar-idu guagwar neg-sii-naega an naye.
An bemar-idu-naogu, an bemarga neg-guagwar-sisale, an bemar-sudagega gannar an danibaloed. Adi, an-gudiguoedgi, bemar anba gudii gumogagar.
Bemar wismalad bia an nasokali, degine, igar-maid bemar wismarbalid.”
Jesús, Bab-Dummadse dule-seded
Tomás Jesúsʼga sogded: —Dummad, anmar wissulid bia be nasokali, degite, ¿igi anmar igar-maid wisiosunna?
Jesús, abin-sogded: —Anbi unnila Bab-Dummadse be-sedoed. Ani an napiragwadid, degine, dulagudigued angi danikid. Dule angi nasulile, geg Bab-Dummadse warmaked.
Ar magar be an-dakmalana, an doa-dule, ar be an-Bab magar dakmarmoganad. Ar emigindi, bato bemar mag an-Bab-dakmalad, ar ade, bemar bato an-Bab-daksamalad.
Felipe Jesúsʼga sogded: —Dummad, Bab-Dummad be anmarga oyoge. Geb anmar gusbin itogoed.
Jesús, abin-sogded: —Felipe, an bemar-abargi dikasurgus an gudiidde, ¿amba be aku an-dakde? Ar dule an-daksale, a-dule bato an-Bab-daksado. ¿Ibiga be anse egise, Bab be anga oyoye?
¿Ar bemar Babgi-an-gudiid bensi? ¿Ar bemar Bab-angi-gudimogad benmarbarsi? Ibmar-an-sogedi, an-itolegedba wargwengi an sogsulid. Bab-angi-maidi, angi ibmar imakmaid.
Mer be an-bengumar. An-Babgi an gudiid, degi, Bab angi gudimogad. Degisulile, an-ibmar-dakledisulid-imakedgi mer be an-bengumar.
An napira bemarga soged, ar dule angi bensulile, an-ibmar-imakedi, a-dule imakmogoed. Degine, a-dule bur bule ibmar-dummagan imakoed. Ar ade, an-Babse an naesokalid.
An-nuggi bela an-Babse be ibmar egisele, an bega imakoed, adi, Bab na E-Machigi nug ganguegar.
Ibmar-gwensak an-nuggi be egisele, an bega imakoed.
Jesús sogsad, Bab-Burba-Isligwaled an barmidagoye
Jesús sogdebar: “Ar be an-sabmalale, an-igar-mamaidba be damaloed.
An-Babse an bemarga egisoed, be-bendaked-baid, bemar-Gwage-Armaked, bemarga barmidaye. Adi, degisadegu bemarba gudiguegar.

Dule-Bab-Dummad-wissurmalad gege we-Burba-Napiragwadi, abingaed. Ar ade, sanar daksurmalad, deginbali, amba aku dakmarbalid. Ar bemardi, we-Burba-Napiragwad mag-daked, ar bemarba gudiid, degine, bemargi gudii gubaloed.
”Bemar, nusgana-babgansulidyob wargwen an be-metosurmalad. An bemarse gannar danibaloed.
Ichesaar napid, we-napneg-naidgi-bukmalad bipisaale bar an-dakosulid. Bemardi, an-dakmaloed. Ar an dula gudisoggu, bemar dula-gudigumosunnoed.
A-ibagine, an-Babgi-an-gudiid bemar magar itogoed. Bemar-angi-gudimogad, degine, an-bemargi-gudimogad, magar be itomarbaloed.
Ar dule, an-igar-mamaid sediile, degine, ar aba gudiile, we-dule, nue-an-sabed. Ar dule, an-sabele, an-Bab a-dule sabgumogoed. An a-dule sabgumogoed, degine, an ese magarobaloed, an doa-dule gue.”
Judas (Judas-Iscarioteʼsulid) Jesúsʼga sogded: —Dummad, ¿ibiga be anmarsebi magarogoe? ¿Dulemar-beba-naisurmaladsedi be magarogosuli?
Jesús abin-imakdegu, sogded: —Ar dule an-sabele, an-gayaburba-sunmakedba daoed, degine, an-Bab a-dule-sabgumogoed, degine, anmar a-dulegi-megega ese nonikoed.
Ar dule an-sabsulile, an-gayaburba-sunmakedba daosulid. Bemar an-ibmar-sogsad-itosmaladi, an-itolegedba an ibmar sogsasulid. An-Bab-an-barmialid-sogedba an ibmar soged.
”An bemar-abargi-dula-gudiidgi we-ibmar-an-bemarga sognaid.
Bab an-nuggi Dule-Gwage-Armaked barmidagoed. A-dule, Bab-Dummad-Burba-Isligwaledid. A bela bemar-odurdaknonikoed, degine, bela-an-ibmar-sogsad gannar insaega bemar-imakoed.

”Ulubgi-bogidik-itogega an bemar-imaked. An na ulubgi-bogidik-itogedyob an bemar-imakmogad. Ulubgi-bogidik-itogega-an-bemar-imakedi, dule-we-napnegginmalad-gwage-bogidik-ukedyob an bemarga uksulid. Mer be surbinsa be-gwagegi be itomar, mer be dobgumar.

”An-bega-sogsamaladi be an-itosmalad: ‘An nae, gannar an bemarse danibaloed.’ Ar bemar an-sabmalana weligwar be itosmalanad. Ar ade, an bemarga sogsad an-Babse an naesokarye. An-Bab anba bur dummadid.
Emigindi, iduakwaa an bemarga sognaid, adi, deyob gunonikile, mer angi be bengumalagar.
”Bemarga bar suitii an sunmakosulid. Ar ade, we-napneggi-dummadga-gudiid, Nia-saila, danikid. We-dule, angi obinega gangued-sated.

Degi-inigwele, we-napneggi-dule-bukmalad, an Bab-sabed, degi, Bab-Dummad-an-barmialidba an ibmar-imaked, wisguer gebed.” Jesús bela weyob sogsad-sorba, e-sapinganga sogded: “Gwisgumar, anmar namarsun.”
